$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs (manager/rules/SEO.md). No actorId yet: the first CI deploy creates the actor, private, and its ID goes here before the next push.
seoTitle: Y Combinator Jobs Scraper - Salary, Equity & Visa
seoDescription: Search every open job at YC startups on Work at a Startup by title, batch, place and pay. Get salary, equity, visa terms and the exact posting date.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Planned 1 GB, from local runs on 2026-11-10: a run reads every hiring YC company's job list (1,500 calls, 2.8 s of CPU on the laptop), which is CPU-bound on a small share of a core, and one start event covers up to 1 GB. Phase B measures 512 MB, 1 GB and 2 GB on Apify and sets it.

pricing.$comment: PLACEHOLDER prices, not measured on Apify: the markup ladder (FREE 100%, BRONZE 95%, SILVER 90%, GOLD 85%, PLATINUM and DIAMOND 80%) on local estimates of about $0.002 fixed per run and $0.000008 a row. Phase B measures the cost on Apify and replaces every number here, in README.md and in llms.txt. apply false: store-metadata.mjs does not touch pricing.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, places, remote or office, role, YC batch, pay and equity, visa terms, experience, team size, exact posting date and link. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, whether it offers equity, and the city, state and country of its first place.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
